notes.title: Update 1. First Fixes, Mission Markers, and More
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

So sorry this has taken so long. We’ve been head-down fixing many of the issues that have been shared with us since launch.

Today, we’re releasing the first major update to The Waylanders. This update brings some much needed fixes to some critical issues that the game including:

A bug that stopped Ynes´ Mission from finishing correctly
A critical Direct3D bug affecting configuring the game in fullscreen
Mission markers should now show correctly throughout The Waylanders
We’ve fixed level milestones
Animations in many cinematics have been improved
 
Again, we appreciate your patience and apologize for the delay on these fixes. We’re now working on our next update. We’re still triaging known issues and hope to have a roadmap available soon. 
 
If you have a bug you’ve been encountering, let us know in the comments below, or tell us in detail on The Waylanders Discord in the bugs channel. We want to know more about your experiences.

notes.title: January Update - Launch is Nearly Here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Happy New Year! In under a month, you’ll be jumping into the full release of The Waylanders and we can’t wait to see how you like the continuation of the story. 

Stepping forward a thousand years has absolutely changed the land and the people who inhabit it. Villages have become forts and castles, stone roads have replaced dirt trails, and creatures of magic have gone into hiding. Your companions will change too. Rediscover mortals reborn and seek out immortal friends who have traveled the thousand year road the hard way. 

With advances in crafting, the medieval period holds a whole host of new weapons, armor, and other items to discover and outfit your party with. There’s a lot coming for you to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/ab07919dfcff7eb7b3ca31190ebf8bfe77e81730.png[/img]

Now, on to a few things ahead of launch. 

[b]All That Glitters is Morian Gold[/b]
At full release, The Waylanders will increase in price from $34.99 USD to $39.99 USD. This increase will vary from region to region and serves to reflect the extra content available. 

To offset this increase for RPG fans who haven’t yet jumped in to The Waylanders (and don’t read our community posts) during Early Access, we plan to have the game discounted by 10% for 2 weeks after launch. Beyond that launch discount, you’ll see The Waylanders in future Steam sales. 

We truly appreciate the support of everyone who played during Early Access, especially those who gave feedback or let us know about a bug. Thank you all so much! 

[b]That Which Was Written Will Be Lost[/b]
Unfortunately Early Access save files will not work correctly in the launch build. We know all you Early Access players have put a lot of time into your characters and we’ve looked into many possibilities in how to address this, but we are a small team and have not been able to find a feasible way to make old saves work well.

While you can make copies of your old save files and place them in the save directory, we don’t advise this as doing so can create potentially game breaking bugs in later areas. 


[b]The Story Is Over, But The Work Continues[/b]
No story DLC is currently planned for The Waylanders. After launch, we plan to continue work on The Waylanders, fixing bugs and addressing community feedback that we hear here in the Steam Community, on social media, and in Discord. Watch for updates after launch with fixes, tweaks, and maaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaybe a few extra quests we’d like to add.

[b]Music for the Ages[/b]
At launch, The Waylanders soundtrack will be made available for purchase so The Waylanders fans can have a taste of Inon Zur’s magic whenever they wish. The soundtrack will have 26 tracks totalling approximately 48 minutes long

We’ll have more details up on the soundtrack’s Steam page which will go live at launch.

[b]Distant Digital Lands[/b]
While PC has always been our focus for The Waylanders, we’ve had a lot of requests to have The Waylanders reach other platforms. This is something we’re looking into, but for now we want to focus on ensuring our fans who have committed to the journey on PC have the best experience we can craft.

That’s all from us for now. We’ll have a little more to share before launch, but will largely be focused on polishing The Waylanders for release. Again, thank you all for being along for this journey!

One of the most requested features by RPG fans - and our amazing community in particular - is the ability to explore the passionate world of character romance, and we’re thrilled to announce that it’s here! You will be able to flirt with multiple characters throughout your adventure, the way you want to, and with no limitations in terms of race, class, or gender.

notes.title: Alpha 0.33
notes.content:
Alpha 0.33 brings a whole bunch of new features, many requested by our community: new pets available, a new type of missions (Chore Quests), improved tutorial, corrections in the camera, and revised  enemy distribution... Keep reading to find out more!

[h2]Pets Unlocked![/h2]

[previewyoutube=-1mPqWmoNmc;full][/previewyoutube]

This update gives you access to 5 pets for any Ranger character. Initially, your Ranger character's pet depended on your selected race:
[list]
[*] Mourian: Panther
[*] Werewolf: Wolf
[*] Human: Boar
[*] Half-Fomorian: Spider
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/ce0f5f927243523f4ebdee35c244fdd54e0a5c7a.jpg[/img]
[i]The Wolf, available only for werewolf Rangers in previous versions[/i]

Starting with this update, we’re adding several missions that will unlock these 4 pets for any Ranger. Specifically, they will unlock by completing the Loyalty Quests of these characters:
[list]
[*] Berath: Panther
[*] Mal: Wolf
[*] Brigg: Boar
[*] Xerion: Spider
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/3691b7ec43ba4fa68d9da68bcfdba287cc6e5a0f.jpg[/img]
[i]Now the Boar is not limited to Humans[/i]

But that’s not all! In addition to unlocking these 4 pets for any Ranger, we have added an additional pet. The most dangerous beast of all: the Rabbit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/ea5f991667a2f086d541b10e62436f56dfc41563.jpg[/img] 
[i]Looks cute, hits hard[/i]

Despite its charming appearance, the Rabbit hits harder than it looks at first glance. You will be able to unlock this pet through a [i]Chore Quest[/i] in which you will have to find Goblin masks (you can read more information about the chore quests below).

[h3]Ranger Advanced Class Sneak Peek[/h3]
Since we’re talking about pets, let’s take a quick look at what’s to come for Rangers. The Ranger class will receive much more content in the final version of the game as Advanced Classes are added. We have 3 advanced classes planned: Hunter, Draconic Master and Saboteur. And to go along with these new classes, we’ll be adding... 7 additional pets (two dragon types, a dog, a deer, a bear, a raven, and a magpie)! Here's a little preview of what to expect in the future:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/0f96a40cd31ce80e406c4f37644143c487b368b0.png[/img]
[i]A Saboteur and with a new pet: the Deer[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/f528564bc703d9068f8519c550d53e8586d9f3a9.png[/img]
[i]The Hunter with a Wolf (one of the 5 available pets in Alpha 0.33)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/373ae96f0763df88b1c226a4683ac100ed93413e.png[/img] 
[i]A look at the Draconic Master and... yes, dragons will also be available as pets[/i]

[h2]Chore quests[/h2]
We've added a new type of mission category: Chore Quests! These are small tasks activated by talking to certain NPCs throughout the world of The Waylanders. Complete them to unlock additional lore entries in your Codex as well as some small rewards. One of those rewards is the Rabbit, unlocked by completing the Chore Quest "Where did the Goblins go?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/1490d58a5f014ca2cef160d2f673157756bcd313.png[/img]

We've added 5 Chore Quests in this update:
[list]
[*] The Brotherhood of Blacksmiths
[*] The Ultimate Stew
[*] Godiva in Love
[*] The Beasts of Alucio
[*] Where Did the Goblins Go?
[/list]
Don't forget to talk to NPCs you find in your adventure. You never know who may need your help! More Chore Quests will be added in future updates and when The Waylanders exits Early Access.

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/ae8b509a2f751b26a5cd69e071202596ea661d45.jpg[/img]

We have modified the tutorial, expanding and adding greater detail for sections including:
[list]
[*] Consumable items
[*] How the Ability Queue works
[*] Equipment
[*] How the Formations work
[/list]
In addition, we have included tooltips in the first scenarios of the game to guide the player during their initial steps in the world of The Waylanders.

[h2]Camera system[/h2]
We have reviewed camera behavior to improve handling and avoid problems at certain points where players have reported a bad experience. In addition, some changes have also been made to scenarios to avoid obstacles that reduce visibility and impede control of the camera.
	
[h2]Enemy distribution[/h2]
Building on last month’s update adding new difficulty settings, we’ve reviewed enemy encounters available in Early Access. Some encounters have been improved by adjusting the number, type, and distribution of enemies to improve the gameplay experience on those maps.
		
[h2]Bugfixing[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have resolved a bug that caused the mouse to not work correctly when interacting with some elements of the stage
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 0.32 - Game experience update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/6b3bb3a6075ed67312576723235f01229718369f.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! Apologies for the lack of recent updates. We’ve been working hard to add some new asked-for features and behind-the-scenes bug fixes, as well as planning out updates you’ll be seeing over the course of the Summer. 

[h2]Full Controller Support[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/0b9dba813181fabe5a43c528d04bbf8e7c73e63a.jpg[/img]

We’ve added full controller support to The Waylanders! You can now enjoy The Waylanders using your favorite (PC compatible) controller from start to finish. The full control list is available in the options menu and should show when you turn on your controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/f9c3113e49a819e954bc630f0af6eb6a7b47c980.jpg[/img]

You can switch between the keyboard and the controller at any time, even during play. Just press any key or button on your device and it will be detected as the default. In addition, we have designed an interface for keyboards and another for controllers, so the game will adapt to the device you use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/30a509a74e13d9343b85e1c4360db807c8e64d50.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Difficulty Levels[/h2]

We want all kinds of players to be able to enjoy The Waylanders. With that in mind, we have added 5 difficulty levels to accommodate everyone from those who want to enjoy a relaxed experience focused on the story, to those who like extreme challenges. From now on, you can select a difficulty that best suits your taste.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/d341cfda0cf2e5922fd8ef7da96b66eda613bb61.png[/img]

[b]PEASANT [/b]- An easy experience allowing narrative adventurers to enjoy the story and art in The Waylanders. Your party won't die in combat.
[b]PILGRIM [/b]- Minimal challenge for experienced RPG players. Damage dealt by enemies is reduced. Improved health recovery after battle.
[b]EXPLORER [/b]- The most balanced challenge for most players. Normal levels of health recovery and stats. Normal enemy damage.
[b]WAYLANDER [/b]-The authentic experience of The Waylanders! Damage from enemies is augmented. No health recovery after battle.
[b]NIGHTMARE [/b]- Think you’re a Hero? We'll see! This mode has augmented damage from enemies, no health recovery after battles and defeat will erase all saved games in the profile!

Important: Keep in mind the difficulty selection screen is only available in english. Other translations will be added in future updates.

Is the game too easy for you? Is there a fight that you can't get over and you are stuck? Don't worry, you can change the difficulty in the options menu.

[h2]Bark System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/8f08d910d516ccbbdce3b70ccfcce7113f16f849.jpg[/img]

We've added the Bark System, to give the world of The Waylanders greater richness and depth. Now, virtually every NPC in the game has their own dialogues which will appear overhead. In addition, each NPC  now has their own name and physical appearance.

This provides a greater level of immersion for your adventure. Some NPCs will tell you about where you are, others will give you some tips or share comments about what is happening in the story. In future updates we plan to have some of these newly named NPCs grant small side quests.

Important: Keep in mind the bark system is only available in english. Other translations will be added in future updates.

[h2]Combat Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Improved Ability Queue[/h3]
The Ability Queue has been improved and is now more intuitive.

Abilities depend on two factors to be able to cast: the cooldown time and the ‘resource’. By default, if a character cannot use an ability, they will perform basic attacks until they can use it.

You can now configure this in the options menu. There you can choose if your party will wait for the ability to cool down and / or to obtain enough resources, or if you prefer, they will cancel that ability and use the next one that you have assigned to the ability queue.

[h3]Numerical changes in the combat system[/h3]
We've made changes to the numbers behind The Waylanders combat system, especially when it comes to damage dealt and ability cooldowns. The result is a more balanced combat experience than in previous versions.

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
[h3]More intuitive AI management[/h3]
Many players have reported that the AI ​​management system was not intuitive. We have changed the icons for more descriptive ones that indicate the behavior of the character:

[b]PASSIVE [/b]- You have full control over this character. The AI ​​is deactivated and will not perform more combat actions than you order.
[b]AVERAGE [/b]- The character will actively search for enemies to fight, but will only use basic attacks. They will only use special attacks, abilities or consumables when you order it.
[b]AGGRESSIVE [/b]- The character will actively search for enemies to fight and use special attacks, abilities, and items automatically.

[h3]Better positioning of the information window in Tactical Pause[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/a6e324e3cfb3a6e0353ca59090ca850c035f20fb.jpg[/img]

Information about enemies and characters during Tactical Pause has been placed in a more comfortable position. Now you can quickly consult essential information (enemy type, health, etc.), without losing sight of the battlefield.

[h3]More info about status effects[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/ebfc3fbdfb7529bdc01b050f039991ecba386868.jpg[/img]

We have added more detailed information about each and every one of the game effects in The Waylanders. Consult the Codex to learn more.

[h3]Better highlight for targets in combat[/h3]
The enemy you target will now be highlighted in a more intense way than other opponents. You will now more clearly see which enemy your character is attacking, reducing the feeling of chaos when there are too many enemies in combat.

[h3]Updates and improvements in help texts from the Codex[/h3]
We have revised and corrected some help texts in the Codex. Now the essential information of the game is easier to assimilate.

[h2]Lighting improvements[/h2]
We have made lighting improvements to multiple scenarios and cutscenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/0efe9af467a934fb2cfe171f17edc0ed1d688e2c.jpg[/img]
[i]Lighting in previous versions[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/c2b4ee4357642df5923e625c732d35514742e528.jpg[/img]
[i]Lighting in current version[/i]

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]

Development during Covid has been very challenging, an issue many indie developers have been experiencing over the past year. We’ve had to revamp many of our processes and change up how we work with people outside of the studio, such as our voice actors. We’ve solved many of these challenges and we feel confident that RPG fans will see the full version of The Waylanders released this Fall.

We have more to add to The Waylanders in coming updates including new pets for the Ranger class AND (what many of you have been waiting for) ROMANCES! Check out the new roadmap for more information:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/802d5dff7df4b7a370926445776c47c009faafcf.png[/img]

[i]Can't read it? [url=http://thewaylanders.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/The-Waylanders-Roadmap-Summer-2021.png]The roadmap is available here in HD.[/url][/i]

notes.title: Immersive Update - Alpha 0.30
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/962e122913da20a47d68cb632e5addf4f9f058f8.png[/img]

This new Alpha 0.30 update brings you two powerful features: origins and Photo Mode! Plus, quest improvements and minor changes.

[h2]Character origins[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/8ac94d6cfdd00b0c5f02b90b14032f80ed264c17.jpg[/img]

We've added new videos for the 8 available origins when you customize your adventurer in the Character Creator. Now you can enjoy a deeper background, you can better understand your character's motivations and enjoy a bigger immersion in the story. Also, we've made some minor changes to dialogues, so they are adapted to the origins.

Let's take a look to one of the origin's videos, the Celtic Druid:

[previewyoutube=khQAixGyWt8;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Available origins[/b]
[list]
[*] Celtic Druid
[*] Celtic Soldier
[*] Egyptian
[*] Dog of Ares Mercenary
[*] Mourian Protector
[*] Mourian Diplomat
[*] Alpha Wolf
[*] Slave

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/d3f76259769cb2a01b929023512e487c8ad028af.jpg[/img]

There are 8 different origins, each one with a different cinematic and background. What are you waiting for? Begin a new game, create your character and enjoy this new, lore-friendly cinematics!

[h2]Photo Mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/c7112fc0ddec08307b248b1bd1b85a81d8eddc43.png[/img]

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
Community Update is The Waylanders' biggest change so far! This big patch brings you improved combat experience, better cinematics, additional info for character abilities, rebalanced equipment stats, +150 fixed bugs & issues and more!

[previewyoutube=zh-RZzJl_J0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Combat overhaul[/h2]
We've made multiple changes on combats. Now, battles are more challenging and require more tactical approaches. This means, you'll need to take advantage from your party teamwork to beat your opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/bd606e840dfd792da46047d4912d437c58c3724c.jpg[/img]

We reviewed all the combats and encounters in Act 1, one by one, to provide you a better experience, to balance enemy stats, to adjust battle length... It's a complete overhaul of this part of the game. We would like to know your impressions about that changes, so don't hesitate on share your opinion and feedback with us!

[h2]Equipment system improvement[/h2]
We've reviewed stats for the full list of equipment. This means, you'll notice the change in weapons, armors, shields... Now, equipment max level is 10 instead of 25, and you'll feel more differences between each equipment tier. Also, we've changed combat stats for each equipment item in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/ea5710f9194d02dbf5b4cbcdc204792c93b62187.png[/img]

But it's not just a numerical adjustment. We've made some changes in terms of combat concepts. Before this update, weapons had two base stats: Intuition and Logic. Now, the stats have changed to Offensive and Utility.

[list]
[*] [i]Offensive[/i]: increases the raw damage of basic attacks and abilities.
[*] [i]Utility[/i]: increases the indirect effects of abilities, such as healing and damage over time.
[/list]

We have more plans for the equipment, which will be included in future updates: Forge System will be improved, we'll add Legendary Items (with unique names, special abilities & stats and visual effects), we'll review store prices & item stock to balance commerce...

[h2]In-game cinematics improvement[/h2]
We've reviewed and improved all the in-game cinematics of Act 1. More details, better animations, some fixes...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/3683c1de112c738f05d44ef271bd744fb2857f4e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/186bd18851a1c347eb028c6a8a6e2cb66ad5b78b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/ab5a22bf010504f857a3d7ce655270122fb0aa23.jpg[/img]


[h2]UI additional info for abilities[/h2]
We've added a new layer of information for the abilities. This will help you to better understand the impact and the effects of each ability of your characters. Considering this update will improve the combat in a tactical way, you'll need to know how to use your abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/35de3717cec6f4c1aeb8fc8043866b02a733c2e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Quest fixes and improvements[/h2]
We have fixed a lot of things in Act 1 and we've reviewed the game flow and some gameplay details in 14 quests. From some minor issues to a missing combat versus Tarlock forces.
But the most important part is that we've fixed more than 150 bugs, glitches and minor issues. Yes, more than 150. Many of them are minor changes, but +150 minor improvements are equal to a big improvement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/30e26b7d854fd962a559b1db601f42552ffb91a4.jpg[/img]

The good part here is you'll find less frequent bugs, less errors and the game will be more stable.
The bad part is, you won't find the angry, colored, Fomorian-bodied Amergin anymore:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/c6fad24c318aed3ac679c32a3a7603246be1d0fe.png[/img]

Sorry for the inconvenience. It's the price for solving a big handful of bugs.

We'll keep the hard work in terms of bugfixing, so tell us if you find any problem while enjoying The Waylanders. We check all your reports and feedback.

[h2]Why is this called 'Community Update'?[/h2]
We've made a lot of changes and improvements. Most of them have been made thanks to the help of our community. We've checked all your reports and feedback in the forum. The Waylanders has changed a lot since the release, and this would not have been possible without your help. This update is the best example, as we improved combat, game experience and other features with your support.
We'll keep that in the next updates, but this one is special to us, and we hope you like it too. Thank you in the name of the whole team.

notes.title: The Waylanders - Alpha 0.28
notes.content:
[h2]NEW MAIN QUEST - The Corrupted Coven[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/794ed69739e8a0a5327c4a1b97b403107528edd1.jpg[/img]

Some Mourians are trying to channel the power of the corruption. Nazhedja asks the party to join her in some of the deepest areas of the Underworld, looking for traces of her sisters.
This quest includes some branching situations. You can skip some fights (even a boss!), and solve some conflicts using dialogues instead of weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/09dce5a07039aaa3376272579de24c0ad535afb5.jpg[/img]

[i]The Corrupted Coven[/i] is the longest mission so far, and the last quest of Act 1. Anyway, you can keep playing The Waylanders even when you finish this quest!

[b]Quest requirements[/b]
[i]The Corrupted Coven[/i] requires completing both [i]Corruped Circle [/i]and [i]Blood in the Woods[/i].

[h2]NEW SIDE QUEST - The Agate Eye[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/5e04ecd1261b986445f390c1ca5d76226a1c3574.jpg[/img]

Nazhedja also wants to recover a lost artifact, the Agate Eye, while you’re exploring the underworld caves looking for the coven during the main quest. In wrong hands, it could cause a lot of damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/c44bf1165d9d0371456395c1bbc2d7a965357380.jpg[/img]

[b]Quest requirements[/b]
This quest will trigger during [i]The Corrupted Coven[/i].

[h2]COMBAT TUTORIAL ADDED[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/290bcb8cac2698f85a88bf0ac2798edb039923a5.jpg[/img]

Learn the ropes of the combat system in our new interactive tutorial! Attacking, abilities, formations, equipment... Nytia will tech you the basics.
Oh, and the tutorial also has been adapted to controllers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/5b3ddc156e23c6d2b37cd6b065171a9c52961e5b.jpg[/img]

[b]How to activate the tutorial[/b]
Find Nitya, the mourian trainer, in the deck of the Arbitor, during “Journey to Inisfail”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/45416bc7ee430b5f0cc14727896efeb88e8d318f.jpg[/img]

[h2]OTHER CHANGES AND CLARIFICATIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial[/b]: we've added the combat tutorial in the first quest of the game. But this won't be the only one in the game! We'll include additional tutorials in the future
[*] [b]Map menu[/b]: we've updated all the locations-related images in the menu and in loading screens
[*] [b]Codex[/b]: we've added 'Eye of Agate' entry in the Codex
[*] [b]Known bug[/b]: some quests overlays the HUD. This will be fixed solved during the next week via hotfix
[/list]

[h2]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h2]
Next week, we'll reveal our new steps in a new roadmap. We've read and taken account of your feedback and reports, and we have great plans for The Waylanders. Combat improvement, new languages... Big things are coming! Stay tuned.

notes.title: The Waylanders - Alpha 0.26
notes.content:
[h2]NEW LOYALTY QUEST - KHALDUN[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/fe807526e16125a54c488a2a40e084d1d2aa2598.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/957710/view/1610522339614243125]Khaldhun[/url]'s loyalty quest is now available! In [i]Rite of First Refusal[/i] you’ll know more about her master in necromancy arts, and a powerful artifact.

You can start it getting a letter from Scota in the crow spar, after finishing [i]Corrupted Circle[/i] quest. 

NOTE: the quest is narrative-focused to give the player a legendary, powerful item, but we didn’t implement that system yet. We’ll offer you a stat-boosted weapon instead for the moment! 

[h2]NEW NOTIFICATION SYSTEM[/h2]

We've added a friendly notification system to keep track of everything you unlock, loot and find in a new, easy way! You'll find notification icons on the right side of the screen, as you can see in the image below.

[h2]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS [/h2]

[b]Shops[/b]
We've improved interactions with store items. Now you can select multiple items to sell them at the same time. Also, we've improved the way we group similar items.

[b]Codex[/b]
We've fixed a bug that prevented the codex images from displaying in the right way. We've also made changed in the Codex tab sub-navigation.

[/list]

Although these issues are not currently fixed, we are working on that. Thanks for your feedback and reports!

notes.title: The Waylanders - Alpha 0.25
notes.content:
[h2]NEW LOYALTY QUEST - MAL[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/afcc666737edbb039e94df8f825d634fa30dce47.jpg[/img]

Demons, dead husbands and revenge: it's time for Mal's loyalty quest: [i]'The one that got away'[/i]

Mal is a mid thirties, tough-as-nails butch who loves violence for the sake of violence. Luckily, she has channeled this love into a useful career killing dangerous monsters. The only time she’s seen smiling is when she’s killing something… or licking her knife after doing so. Mal has a unique special ability. She lost an eye in a fight with a monster a number of years ago, and her husband at the time, a Mourian man, saved her life by pouring gold in her empty eye socket. That gold was imbued with magick. Now, if she puts the eye of a deceased creature or person in that eye socket, she can see how that individual died. Well, mostly. She sees their doom through not just their eyes, but their lens- their feelings at their time of death distort the vision. For example, for people who were murdered, the person or creature who murdered them may appear much more horrifying or monstrous than they are in real life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/3103237a83aed88447e1856df26bcd4a90295c93.jpg[/img]

You can activate this loyalty quest talking to Mal in the crew quarters at The Vengeance. You must complete Blood in the Woods before.

In contrast with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/957710/view/4041374038285637467]Berath's narrative-focused quest from Alpha 0.24[/url], this one features more combat, including new boss and miniboss encounters.

[h2]NEW FEATURE - AUTOLOOT[/h2]

Autoloot is now available! This is one of the most requested features from our community. This makes picking up objects easier and improves user experience. Your character will automatically get items when you are closer to them.

In order to use the Autoloot system, you must go Options -> Gameplay and activate the Autoloot option. This also means that, in case you feel comfortable with the classic loot system, you can continue using it instead of Autoloot.

NOTE: although Autoloot system is implemented, we'll improve the way the loot you get is notified in the interface. This will be updated in future alpha patches.

[h2]UI & UX IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[b]Journal & Codex[/b]
We've improved the way the missions are shown. We've separated 'Journal' and 'Codex' contents. From now on, you can find the missions in the 'Journal' tab instead of the 'Codex' one. So, the Codex will focused on lore, characters, locations and other collectibles of the game. This is a more intuitive way to find the most relevant information in different sections of the menu.

Some users reported a major bug when returning to The Vengeance. A black screen appears during the loading screen and crashes the game. It's fixed.

[h2]The Forge - Crafting system added[/h2]
Now you can use the forge to improve your equipment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/644bf0ed01ba4bd811380487f0f91ea4afd513f4.jpg[/img]

[b]What is the forge?[/b]
The forge is a place where you can improve your equippable objects with runes.

[b]What kind of objects can be improved in the forge?[/b]
Weapons, armors, shields and equippable items can be improved with runes.

[b]What are the runes?[/b]
Runes are objects with different powers and effects. Depending on each rune, you'll increase stats, add status effects and/or include magical elements when you add them to your objects.

[b]Can I add any rune to any object?[/b]
No. Each object will have a different number of slots, depending on its type and level. Also, each slot works with a specific rune type. You can add one rune per each slot. So, the limits are the number of slots of the object, and the rune type you can use.

[b]Where is the forge?[/b]
The forge is located in your ship, The Vengeance. You must talk with the NPC with the hammer you can see in the image above. If you need more information about the forge, there is a Codex entry. You can find it in the table, next to that NPC.

[h2]NEW MAP: NETTLE CAVERN[/h2]

As part of today’s update, we’ve added a new map with a twist. Welcome to Nettle Cavern!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/6b5c6ec93b399b454175caf6317445c24dba5c5a.jpg[/img]

Nettle Cavern is an adventurer’s playground where you can practice and experiment with new tactics. Here, you’ll be able to explore the combat potential of companions, party compositions, and Formations in The Waylanders’.

The purpose of Nettle Cavern is to provide a practice area for your party. Winning battles found in this extensive cave won’t provide gold or XP, but enemies will be waiting every time you return to the cave. As you gain experience in the game, you’ll be able to return to Nettle Cavern to try new strategies, abilities, and formations of your leveled up characters.

Nettle Cavern will be available once you have completed the quest called "Back to Life".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/ed2f1599fb8beaa362f6b199730698d53378f69d.jpg[/img]

Keep in mind that you can save your game in Nettle Cavern. You can repeat a specific combat anytime you want. We invite you to experience new combat strategies at Nettle Cavern and share them with the community!

[h2]HOW TO PLAY: NEW TUTORIALS ADDED[/h2]

We’ve added new tutorials at the beginning of the game during the mission "Journey to Inisfail". These tutorials will help players better understand certain key elements of the game, such as the Codex or the mini-map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/8499dd4c0bd686a3c9181ec4b9c431b606a080dd.jpg[/img]

We have added two Codex entries in the “how to play” section to complement the new tutorials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/a9c32c892e42c7ba27f6d39275eecc3e5831e829.jpg[/img]

[h2]GAME EXPERIENCE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have added autosave points every time you visit the ship to avoid having to repeat certain parts of the story whenever you experience a game crash
[*] We have added new autosave points, triggered by completing certain important milestones in the "Back to Life" mission
[*] We have improved game flow of the mission "Back to Life". Now, objectives are more clear and understandable
[/list]

[h2]MAJOR BUG FIXED[/h2]
Some users experienced a bug which freezes the game due to memory instability. This is now fixed. As memory leaks are complex, it could happen again and we are monitoring for future instances. Please contact us via Steam forum if you find this issue during your game again.

[h2]THE WAYLANDERS IS IN CONSTANT IMPROVEMENT[/h2]
Many of the new features introduced in this update are previews, prototypes, and early releases of some things we haven't included in the Early Access yet. We will report new improvements soon!

[h2]KNOWN BUGS[/h2]
Some users reported the enemies stand still without attacking in some situations. We are investigating this. The quick solution at this time is to save your game and reload it. Quick travelling to a different map location and coming back works too. 

[h2]AVAILABLE CONTENT[/h2]
List of current quests available: 
[list]
[*] Journey to Inisfail  
[*] Back to Life  
[*] Blood in the Woods  
[*] Xerion’s Corruption Quests  
[*] Eternal Curiosity  
[*] A Father’s Son 
[/list]
List of cities and locations you can currently visit and explore:
[list]
[*] Brigantia 
[*] Dunnios 
[*] Dumbriga 
[*] Medhu 
[*] Aunes 
[*] Otherworld 
[*] The Vengeance
[/list] 

In addition, some quests have their own maps you can discover. And, of course, you can now visit the new Nettle Cavern location!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/4bb49ff72b8d9dc959f81027b66cefcdd0e22241.jpg[/img]

[h2]OTHER MINOR CHANGES AND FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Consumable items: new icons added
[*] Consumable items: new status effect names added
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[*] Minor performance and optimization improvements
[/list]

notes.title: The Waylanders - Alpha v0.14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/ff46bc14cbe9d4d2d7f160124cf871d16d8dbeb6.png[/img]
 
[h3]CRITICAL PROBLEMS FIXED[/h3]
[list]
[*] F5 previously crashed the game. Now, F5 works for quicksaving. Many thanks to the community for reporting this and suggesting the quicksave option. NOTE: quicksave is not available in combat.

[/list]
 
[h3]QUESTS[/h3]
[list]

[/list]
 
[h3]COMBAT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some enemies were spawning with the same 3D model, regardless of their rank. This issue has been solved and they now spawn with the right enemy appearance.
[*] Defeated enemies don't respawn after loading your saved game.
[*] Arrow formations: autoattack range has been adjusted. Now inflicts damage correctly.
[*] Ranged abilities have been adjusted, including formations with ranged abilities.
[*] Now you can use TAB for quick targeting in combat. Select the nearest enemy by pressing it.
[/list]
 
[h3]INVENTORY & ITEMS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Consumable items stack properly in the inventory.
[*] Duplicate weapons don't disappear from your inventory when you equip one of them.
[*] Some deprecated items have been removed from the merchant & stores (runes).
[/list]
 
[h3]INTERFACE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mini-map improvements.
[*] Map menu improvements.
[*] Support for 21.9" screens.
[/list]
 
[h3]SOUND[/h3]
[list]
[*] Abilities volume adjustment (specially Delba's abilities)
[/list]
 
[h3]OTHER FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] CPU optimization
[*] Minor changes in Codex menu & scrolls.
[*] Other minor bugs fixed.
[/list]
 
[h3]KNOWN BUGS[/h3]
There are many important bugs which are affecting the game experience. Many of them have been reported in the Steam forum. But there is a specific one which really annoy some players. The game freezes in some situations. We've detected instability issues in the abilities screen from the menu. We are investigating this and will fix it as quick as possible. This is a priority for us.
 
[h3]WE ARE WORKING HARD... WITH YOUR HELP[/h3]
Thanks to your help, we are progressing faster than expected in terms of bug detection. We know Early Access is a long-distance race, but we are working hard to solve problems, so you can enjoy a better gameplay experience.
 
We are checking all your reports, suggestions and feedback in the Steam Alpha forum [https://steamcommunity.com/app/957710/discussions/1/]. We are reading all the messages, one by one, so we have the opportunity to get to know first hand the problems you are experiencing. Your help is a game-changer. Literally.
 
Apart from bug reports, we are taking note of your suggestions and ideas. Many of them are being really useful and we appreciate that. We want you to be proud of being part of our community, so we'll keep up the hard work to help The Waylanders grow. We won't disappoint you.
 
Thanks,

The Waylanders Team

notes.title: Discover the world of The Waylanders (Part 1)
notes.content:
[h1]VIDEO PREVIEW[/h1]

Check out this flythrough video featuring some of the main regions seen in the Celtic Age of The Waylanders. This is early footage not including NPCs and area decorations, but we think you'll love it:
https://youtu.be/PrnJpyxm-MM

[h1]The Waylanders and the Celtic World[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/53353cc595c9c85dc3d101889b6789f9056b0432.jpg[/img]

The adventure begins in the Celtic region of Kaltia, an area now known as Galicia in Northwestern Spain. The story of The Waylanders is very much inspired by the history and mythology of the time, and Kaltia plays into that. In Kaltia, many different religions, cultures, mortal and immortal human races, werewolves, druids, goblins, and monsters weave together into the complex tapestry that makes up this ancient kingdom. Keep reading for the first three locations!

Keep reading for the first three locations!

[h2]Brigantia[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/97ed1798001da1fe4538cc312459cbd331b94b5a.jpg[/img]

The capital of these lands is Brigantia, a bustling coastal city, and home to King Ith and his court. As the largest city of all Kaltia, Brigantia is the most densely populated and is defended by a nearby hillfort. Humans from neighboring nationalities pass through, making it a major center of trade and commerce.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/995163feadfa0f7b20ca517c53d636e5d23c8ebc.jpg[/img]

As a trading hub and a culture known for its openness, Brigantia reflects humanity’s beautiful diversity. You will meet human characters in the game who represent many nationalities, sexualities, ethnicities, and beliefs. Their personalities and ethics will be fiercely individual but always informed by their personal histories and cultural identities, just as with humans in our world.

[b]Tower of Brigantia[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/b44e51cc45c81af9bfa9ba5059e392f971654416.jpg[/img]

The Tower, a nearby ancient lighthouse, guides sailors from distant lands to port and is known as a beacon for the ancient races. Its flame is a symbol of the city as much as it is a useful landmark for travelers. 

[h2]Dumbriga[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/4b5d98c15d3cf2a3a99182165c594d6b12401eae.jpg[/img]

Dumbriga is a smaller city to the south of Brigantia. The home of the University, Druids from all over Kaltia come here to study and perfect their magickal crafts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/b556ad8e623a57e6ede86cbd556c90af81e83846.jpg[/img]


[b]The Olympus of the Celts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/5977e274b1f0dd912f632271f7bf85996e55aae9.jpg[/img]

At the center of town, a mountain commonly called The Olympus of the Celts is said to house several elder gods, and is off-limits to all but the most advanced Druids.

[h2]Mourian Underworld[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/269b05d14c160927bc8630e8be2f7af4b26a5b89.jpg[/img]

The Mourian Underworld is a vast underground network of cities and towns that spans throughout Kaltia. Mourian architecture is elegant and lavishly decorated — parts of Mourian bodies are made of gold and so are their homes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33772616/c5e4483d57538eb931dff62bacd53dbd7ca6c4f8.jpg[/img]

There are few doors through which you can travel to their society, but those that are known are large and well guarded.

notes.title: The Waylanders Soundtrack - Main Theme by Inon Zur

Today is a great day: one year ago, The Waylanders was funded on Kickstarter!

And we want to celebrate this moment, sharing with you something you're going to love: The Waylanders main theme, composed by Inon Zur. Listen and enjoy:

[previewyoutube=qcWBzTIs-Xk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h1]Who's Inon Zur?[/h1][/b]

[b]EMMY award-winner and three-time BAFTA nominated composer Inon Zur[/b] is internationally renowned for his emotionally dynamic original music scores for video games, including the Fallout series, Dragon Age series, Icewind Dale and much more.

Zur’s best-selling soundtrack for Fallout 4 has been described as 'sophisticated and atmospheric' and celebrated as one of the best original video game scores by the British Academy of Film and Television Arts or The PlayStation Awards, to name a few examples.

Recently, he has been nominated for two relevant awards:
[list]
[*] Jerry Goldsmith Awards: Best Original Video Game Score - Fallout 76
[*] Hollywood Music in Media Awards: Best Song/Score for Mobile Video Game - The Elder Scrolls: Blades
[/list]
Dragon Age, Icewind Dale, Fallout, The Elder Scrolls... That's why we know he's the right person to compose the soundtrack of our RPG!
